SELECT TO_CHAR(E.BASIC_NO) AS BASIC_NO, TO_CHAR(E.PLAN_NO) AS PLAN_NO, AS SYLLABUS_COUNT, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(E.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_TYPE_CODE_NAME, E.COURSE_NAME_CODE, TO_CHAR(E.PERIOD_TIME) AS PERIOD_TIME, TO_CHAR(E.IMPLE_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS IMPLE_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(E.IMPLE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS IMPLE_END_DATE, E.IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR, E.IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT, TO_CHAR(E.APPLY_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS APPLY_END_DATE, AS APPLY_COUNT, AS PLAN_COUNT FROM EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION E JOIN EDU_PLAN_MANAGER M ON M.PLAN_NO = E.PLAN_NO WHERE E.ACTIVITY = '1' AND E.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND M.ISNOT_APPLY = 'Y' AND E.APPLY_END_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HR_EMPLOYEE H WHERE H.PERSON_ID = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND DBMS_LOB.INSTR(',' || E.PLAN_EMPLOYEE_EMPID || ',', ',' || H.EMPID || ',') > 0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EDU_STUDENT_APPLY A WHERE A.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO AND A.STU_PERSON_ID = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.ACTIVITY = 1)
AND UPPER(E.COURSE_NAME_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{search.courseName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%'
AND E.IMPLE_START_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{search.startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
AND E.IMPLE_END_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{search.endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
AND TO_CHAR(E.BASIC_NO) IN #{no, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
ORDER BY E.CREATE_DATE DESC

SELECT HH.PERSON_ID, HH.EMPID, HH.LOCAL_NAME, HH.DEPTNO, GET_DEPT_NAME(HH.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HH.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_GRADE_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HH.POSITION_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POSITION_NAME FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HH WHERE HH.PERSON_ID = (SELECT D.MANAGER_EMP_ID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT D WHERE D.DEPTNO = (SELECT H.DEPTNO FROM HR_EMPLOYEE H WHERE H.PERSON_ID = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ROWNUM = 1) AND ROWNUM = 1) AND ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDU_STUDENT_APPLY (APPLY_NO, BASIC_NO, STU_PERSON_ID, STU_LOCAL_NAME, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_IP, CPNY_ID, APPLY_TASK) VALUES (#{applyNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{basicNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, (SELECT H.LOCAL_NAME FROM HR_EMPLOYEE H WHERE H.PERSON_ID = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ROWNUM = 1), 1, SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{applyTask, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

INSERT INTO EDU_TRAIN_MAKER (MAKER_NO, APPLY_NO, MAKER_PERSON_ID, MAKER_LOCAL_NAME, MAKER_LEVEL, APPLY_FLAG, CONFIRM_FLAG, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_IP, CPNY_ID) SELECT EDU_TRAIN_MAKER_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{applyNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, H.PERSON_ID, H.LOCAL_NAME, #{makerLevel, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 1, 1, 1, SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} FROM HR_EMPLOYEE H WHERE H.PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ROWNUM = 1
mapper.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(T.MAKER_NO) AS MAKER_NO, TO_CHAR(A.APPLY_NO) AS APPLY_NO, TO_CHAR(A.BASIC_NO) AS BASIC_NO, TO_CHAR(B.PLAN_NO) AS PLAN_NO, AS SYLLABUS_COUNT, H.EMPID, NVL(H.LOCAL_NAME, A.STU_LOCAL_NAME) AS STU_LOCAL_NAME, GET_DEPT_NAME(H.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_GRADE_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(B.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_TYPE_CODE_NAME, B.COURSE_NAME_CODE, TO_CHAR(B.PERIOD_TIME) AS PERIOD_TIME, TO_CHAR(B.IMPLE_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS IMPLE_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(B.IMPLE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS IMPLE_END_DATE, B.IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR, B.IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT, TO_CHAR(A.CREATE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS APPLY_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.APPLY_TASK) AS APPLY_TASK, TO_CHAR(T.APPLY_FLAG) AS APPLY_FLAG, TO_CHAR(T.CONFIRM_FLAG) AS CONFIRM_FLAG, T.MAKER_LOCAL_NAME, TO_CHAR(T.MAKER_LEVEL) AS MAKER_LEVEL, AS APPLY_COUNT, AS PLAN_COUNT, CASE WHEN A.STU_PERSON_ID = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MINE_FLAG FROM EDU_TRAIN_MAKER T JOIN EDU_STUDENT_APPLY A ON A.APPLY_NO = T.APPLY_NO AND A.ACTIVITY = 1 JOIN EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION B ON B.BASIC_NO = A.BASIC_NO AND B.ACTIVITY = '1' LEFT JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE H ON H.PERSON_ID = A.STU_PERSON_ID WHERE T.ACTIVITY = 1 AND T.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
